question: A fee is raised by some percentage and then cut by the same percentage, leaving it 6.25% below where it began. What was the percentage?

question: The radius of a circle is increased by some percentage and its area increases by 21%. By what percentage was the radius increased?
solution: The area depends on radius × radius: (1 + r)² = 1.21, so 1 + r = 1.1 and the radius grew by 10%.

question: A shopkeeper marks an article 25% above its cost price and then gives a 20% discount on the marked price. Compared with the cost price, what is the selling price?
solution: Selling price = cost × 1.25 × 0.8 = cost × 1, so it equals the cost price: no change.
questionHi: एक दुकानदार किसी वस्तु पर क्रय मूल्य से 25% अधिक मूल्य अंकित करता है और फिर अंकित मूल्य पर 20% छूट देता है। क्रय मूल्य की तुलना में विक्रय मूल्य क्या है?
solutionHi: विक्रय मूल्य = क्रय मूल्य × 1.25 × 0.8 = क्रय मूल्य × 1, अतः यह क्रय मूल्य के बराबर है: कोई परिवर्तन नहीं।
